layering.description: backend/src/config/ imports only from backend/src/types/ (stdlib aside) -- never from backend/src/db/, backend/src/repositories/, backend/src/services/, backend/src/api/, or any UI/frontend code -- Config is Layer 2, per .claude/architecture.md. Verified by backend/tests/architecture/test_config_layer_imports.py.
layering.no_module_level_cache: backend/src/config/fraud_rules_config.py and backend/src/config/assessment_rules_config.py re-read and re-validate their JSON file from disk on every call to their load_*_config() function -- no module-level singleton -- so an on-disk edit is reflected on the very next load with no code change (E2-S1 AC4). Verified by test_load_fraud_rules_config_reflects_on_disk_edit_on_next_load and test_load_assessment_rules_config_reflects_on_disk_edit_on_next_load in backend/tests/unit/config/.
